_comment: TEMPLATE for a 2.4 GHz receiver (Flydigi / 8BitDo / GameSir / etc.). Files whose names start with '_' are NOT loaded by the daemon: copy to config/devices/<id>.json and fill it in. All values below are PLACEHOLDERS, not the real protocol of any vendor. The real handshake bytes and the bit map must be obtained from your device: (1) `lsusb -d <vid>:<pid>` -> VID/PID; (2) `gamepad-remapd sniff /dev/hidrawN` -> button positions (including M1–M4/C/Z); (3) if the receiver stays silent until the vendor mode is activated, capture the USB traffic of the vendor's official software (Wireshark + usbmon on Linux, USBPcap on Windows) and move the feature/output reports into 'handshake'.
name: Template 2.4G receiver

handshake._note: HIDIOCSFEATURE / hid_send_feature_report; the first byte = Report ID (00 if there is no numbering)
read the reply for diagnostics (log only)
